subject: Senior Infra Engineer — project deliverable & reviewer ops
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hooper <jordan.hooper@example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Senior Infra Engineer — project deliverable & reviewer ops

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with us. As discussed, attached is a short project that lets us get a sense for your systems design and inference-serving tradeoffs.

Deliverables (one PDF or repo link):
- short design doc (max 2 pages) outlining architecture and tradeoffs
- a small artifact (Dockerfile + README or runnable notebook)
- 3 bullet summary of latency/cost considerations and testing approach

Deadline: 72 hours from now (Mon, Apr 5 by EOD Pacific). If you need more time, tell me and we'll accommodate.

Submit by replying to this thread with a link and/or zipped artifact. If file is >10MB, please upload to Drive and share the link.

Attachments: infra-exercise.pdf (exercise prompt, ~2 pages)

Next steps on our side: Marissa and Laura will be assigned as reviewers and will coordinate a 30–45 minute async rubric review once you submit.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Hiring Manager, Infra
Redwood Inference

Attachment: infra-exercise.pdf (prompt, PDF stub)

From: Jordan Hooper <jordan.hooper@example.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Senior Infra Engineer — project deliverable & reviewer ops

Thanks Marcus — got it. I'll start today and aim to submit before the deadline. Quick Q: is it OK to assume use of public cloud (GCP) for the architecture portion? Or should I include an on-prem note?

Best,
Jordan

Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Senior Infra Engineer — project deliverable & reviewer ops

Hi team,

Jordan acknowledged receipt (see thread). When the candidate submits I'd like us to do a quick async review (rubric below) and each provide a short score + 6–8 bullet notes.

Plan:
- Reviewer assignments: Marissa (systems + infra ops), Laura (latency/cost tradeoffs)
- Target for completed reviewer notes: 24 hours after submission
- Consolidated decision call only if scores diverge >2 points

Action: Marissa, please create a small CSV with reviewer slots and a scoring column and post to Drive. I attached a template (reviewer-assignments.csv). Also here's the rubric link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qX-example-rubric

Thanks — I can triage any conflicts. I'll ping TAL if we need an extra reviewer.

Marcus

Attachment: reviewer-assignments.csv (template)

Hi Marcus — submitting my deliverable here. Thanks for the clear prompt.

Link to repo: https://github.com/jhooper/ri-infra-exercise (public)
Zip (attached): jordan_hooper_solution.zip (~4.8MB)

Summary:
- design.pdf (1.5 pages)
- Dockerfile + sample service in /service
- short notes on cost/perf tradeoffs and simple benchmark results

Let me know if you'd like anything else.

Best,
Jordan
